title_fa: رندرِ ویدیوی سه‌بعدی روی کارت گرافیک (Blender 4.5 + Cycles با OptiX)
note: Blender 4.5.14 LTS for Windows (GPL-3.0; it is only run, never linked) from the site's own mirror (data/up3d/downloads/blender-windows.zip, the official zip of blender.org), size and sha256 checked, unpacked to <data>/vendor/blender. Then a real check: Blender is started once and Cycles must list an OptiX (RTX) or CUDA device. up3d_jobs.py runs the render as a compute job so the card is shared with the other heavy jobs one at a time. HDRI lighting files (Poly Haven, CC0) travel with the code in assets/hdri.

items.title: Cycles sees the graphics card (OptiX, else CUDA)
